title: Apostate immutable release manifest
description: Machine-readable identity and integrity metadata for one immutable Apostate release artifact. The SHA-256 fields provide integrity: a consumer must hash the complete archive and require an exact match with sha256 before extracting it. Build provenance is attested separately and keylessly by GitHub artifact attestations, verified with `gh attestation verify <artifact> --repo <owner>/<repo>`; there is no detached signature and no long-lived signing key. This manifest contains no credentials or private signing material.

package_version.description: Apostate package release version. The release-candidate contract is immutable at 0.1.0.

chromium_version.description: Chromium version embedded in the artifact.

catalogue_version.description: Version of the Apostate-owned profile catalogue the signed source revision actually shipped. The contract pins the rule, not the number: the manifest must state the catalogue present in resources/profiles/catalogue.json at the tagged revision.

platform.description: The exact binary target represented by artifact.

artifact.description: Immutable artifact filename. It is deliberately restricted to the release naming contract and cannot contain a path or credential-bearing URI.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the complete artifact bytes.

source_revision.description: Exact 40-character lowercase Git revision used for the source checkout.

build_manifest_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the build manifest that produced this artifact.
